package consumer

import (
    "context"
    "github.com/progresshans/godj/api"
    "github.com/progresshans/godj/api/endpoint"
    "github.com/progresshans/godj/api/input"
    "github.com/progresshans/godj/api/openapi"
    "github.com/progresshans/godj/api/output"
    "github.com/progresshans/godj/auth"
    "github.com/progresshans/godj/serializers"
    "github.com/progresshans/godj/validation"
    "github.com/progresshans/godj/web"
)

type listDTO struct { Name input.Presence[string] }

func listEndpoint(ctx context.Context, authentication api.Authentication, request *web.Request, objects []serializers.Object) ([]openapi.Operation, []openapi.NamedSchema, error) {
    name, err := serializers.StringField("name")
    if err != nil { return nil, nil, err }
    spec, err := serializers.NewSpec([]serializers.Field{name})
    if err != nil { return nil, nil, err }
    body, err := input.New(spec, api.ParserConfig{}, input.Field("name", input.String(), func(r *listDTO, p input.Presence[string]) { r.Name = p }))
    if err != nil { return nil, nil, err }
    bounds := input.ListConfig{MinItems:1, MaxItems:20, Parser:api.ParserConfig{MaxBodyBytes:8192}, ItemLimits:serializers.Limits{MaxDocumentBytes:1024}}
    validator := func(context.Context,listDTO)(validation.Errors,error){ return validation.Errors{},nil }
    list, err := input.NewList(body, bounds, validator)
    if err != nil { return nil, nil, err }
    _, err = list.Schema(serializers.ModeFull)
    if err != nil { return nil, nil, err }
    _, _, err = list.Bind(ctx, objects, serializers.ModePartial)
    if err != nil { return nil, nil, err }
    _, _, err = list.Parse(request, serializers.ModeFull)
    if err != nil { return nil, nil, err }
    _, _ = list.Bounds()
    response, err := output.New(output.Array(output.String(),1,20),serializers.Limits{})
    if err != nil { return nil, nil, err }
    item := endpoint.JSONBody("ListItem",body,serializers.ModeFull,"Item.")
    prepared, err := endpoint.New(authentication,endpoint.Config[[]listDTO,[]string]{
        Route:web.Route{Name:"consumer:many",Method:"POST",Path:"/many/"}, Admission:endpoint.Authenticated(),
        Input:endpoint.NoQuery(endpoint.JSONListBody(item,bounds,"List.",validator)), Output:response,
        ErrorLimits:serializers.Limits{MaxValues:65536}, SummarizeValidationErrors:true,
        Success:[]endpoint.Status{{Code:201,Description:"Created."}},
        Handle:func(request *web.Request,_ auth.Principal,values []listDTO)(output.Prepared[[]string],error){
            names:=make([]string,len(values));for i,value:=range values{names[i],_=value.Name.Get()};return response.Prepare(request.Context(),201,names)
        },
    })
    if err != nil { return nil, nil, err }
    return endpoint.Collect([]endpoint.Endpoint{prepared})
}
